text: No, the entire property was not cleared in 2021. Satellite data shows that about **81.3 hectares (2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property)** experienced tree-cover loss that year. Most of this loss (68.1 ha) occurred in planted forests (Pinus species), with a smaller portion (13.2 ha) outside mapped forest areas. The loss was not uniform—it consisted of distinct patches, mostly larger than 0.5 ha. Smaller patches (37.3 ha) were excluded from the total. The remaining 97.8% of the property retained tree cover. Thus, while some clearing or harvesting happened, it was limited and not a full property clearance.
